method_card.title: School Subjects and the School Day
method_card.content:
This lesson covers school subject vocabulary, telling the time and giving reasoned opinions about your timetable using comparatives and porque.

SpanishEnglish
las matemáticasMaths
las cienciasScience
la historiaHistory
la geografíaGeography
la educación físicaPE
la informáticaICT/Computing
el dibujo / el arteArt
la músicaMusic
los negociosBusiness Studies
divertido/afun
aburrido/aboring
difícildifficult
útiluseful
más... quemore... than
mejor quebetter than

Grammar focus — gustar and comparatives: Me gusta takes a singular noun or verb (me gusta el español) but me gustan takes a plural noun (me gustan las ciencias). Comparatives: más + adjective + que (more than), menos + adjective + que (less than). Irregulars: mejor (better), peor (worse). Superlative: la asignatura más + adjective.

Model paragraph: Me encantan las ciencias porque son muy interesantes. La historia es más difícil que el español pero es más útil. Mi asignatura preferida es la informática porque es la más práctica.
(I love Science because it is very interesting. History is more difficult than Spanish but more useful. My favourite subject is ICT because it is the most practical.)
steps: Learn all school subject names with their correct articles
Master the gustar construction: me gusta (singular) vs me gustan (plural)
Use comparatives — más/menos... que and the irregular mejor/peor
Give justified opinions with porque, ya que or dado que

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — school subjects appear every year across all skills

worked_examples.question: Translate: Me gustan las ciencias porque son interesantes.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Me gustan — plural because las ciencias is plural. Literally 'sciences please me'. = I like Science.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: porque son interesantes = because they are interesting. Son (plural) agrees with las ciencias.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: I like Science because it is interesting.

worked_examples.question: Compare: 'History is more difficult than Spanish.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Use the comparative structure: más + adjective + que.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: History = la historia (feminine), difficult = difícil (same for m/f), Spanish = el español. Adjectives ending in a consonant do not change for gender.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: La historia es más difícil que el español.

worked_examples.question: Translate into Spanish: 'Languages are the most useful subjects because they help you to get a good job.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Languages = los idiomas (masculine plural). Superlative: las asignaturas más útiles — notice las (feminine plural) because las asignaturas is feminine.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: They help you = te ayudan (plural, because los idiomas). Get a good job = conseguir un buen trabajo — buen before masculine singular noun.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Los idiomas son las asignaturas más útiles porque te ayudan a conseguir un buen trabajo.

bronze.question: Match the Spanish school subjects to their English meaning
Match the Spanish opinion words to their English meaning

gaps.correct_explain: gustan (plural) because las matemáticas is plural. The verb agrees with the thing liked.

wrong.gusta: gusta is singular. Las matemáticas is plural → me gustan.
wrong.gusto: gusto is not correct here. Gustar agrees with the thing liked, not the person.

wrong.están: están is from estar. Use ser for describing the nature of subjects.

bronze.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: es el español porque es muy

gaps.correct_explain: preferida agrees with asignatura (feminine). Mi asignatura preferida = my favourite subject.
divertido agrees with el español (masculine). The adjective must match the noun.

bronze.question: What does 'La informática es más divertida que la geografía' mean?
options: ICT is more fun than Geography
ICT is less fun than Geography
ICT is as fun as Geography
Geography is more fun than ICT

bronze.question: Which sentence correctly says 'I don't like Maths at all'?
options: No me gustan nada las matemáticas
No me gusta nada las matemáticas
No me gustan las matemáticas nada
Me no gustan nada las matemáticas

bronze.source_text: Me encanta la educación física porque es divertida. No me gustan las matemáticas porque son aburridas.
model_answers: I love PE because it is fun. I don't like Maths because it is boring.

bronze.audio_text: Me gusta el español porque es fácil.
bronze.correct_text: Me gusta el español porque es fácil.
bronze.translation: I like Spanish because it is easy.

silver.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: interesantes que las matemáticas pero la historia es la asignatura

wrong.tan: tan means 'as'. The English says 'more... than' → más... que.

gaps.correct_explain: la asignatura más difícil = the most difficult subject. Superlative: la + noun + más + adjective.

wrong.menos: menos would make it 'least difficult'. The English says 'most' → más.

silver.english: Science is more interesting than Maths but History is the most difficult subject.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: La historia es más divertido que la geografía.
silver.explanation: La historia is feminine, so the adjective must be divertida (feminine), not divertido (masculine).
silver.translation: History is more fun than Geography.

silver.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
silver.english: History is better than PE because it is more interesting.

distractor_labels.buena: wrong form — the comparative of buena is the irregular form mejor, not más buena

silver.source_text: My favourite subject is ICT because it is the most practical. I don't like History because it is boring.
model_answers: Mi asignatura preferida es la informática porque es la más práctica. No me gusta la historia porque es aburrida.

silver.question: Listen and type what you hear
silver.audio_text: La historia es más difícil que el español pero es muy interesante.
silver.correct_text: La historia es más difícil que el español pero es muy interesante.
silver.translation: History is more difficult than Spanish but it is very interesting.

silver.question: Put these words in the correct order to form a sentence

gold.source_text: I love Music and Art because they allow me to be creative. However, Maths classes seem difficult to me and they are not very fun. In my opinion, languages are the most useful subjects.
model_answers: Me encantan la música y el dibujo porque me permiten ser creativo. Sin embargo, las clases de matemáticas me parecen difíciles y no son muy divertidas. En mi opinión, los idiomas son las asignaturas más útiles.
gold.ai_system_prompt: You are a GCSE Spanish examiner marking a translation from English to Spanish. Source: '{source}'. Model answer: '{model}'. Accept any grammatically correct translation that conveys the same meaning. Check: gustar/encantar agreement, comparatives, superlative, adjective agreement with feminine plural nouns. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"2-3 sentences","improvement":"optional correction"}

gold.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
gold.english: Languages are the most useful subjects because they help you to get a good job.

distractor_labels.ayuda: wrong number — los idiomas is plural (they help), so ayudan not ayuda
distractor_labels.bueno: wrong position — before masculine singular nouns, bueno shortens to buen
distractor_labels.útil: wrong number — las asignaturas is plural, so útiles not útil

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are at a leisure centre in Spain on a school exchange visit. The activity coordinator asks you about your school subjects.

bullets.prompt: Say which subject is your favourite and why.
bullets.model_answer: Mi asignatura preferida es la informática porque es muy divertida y práctica.
bullets.note: mi asignatura preferida (feminine agreement) + opinion + porque

bullets.prompt: Compare two subjects using a comparative.
bullets.model_answer: La historia es más interesante que la geografía pero las matemáticas son más difíciles.

bullets.prompt: Say which subject you think is the most useful and explain why.
bullets.model_answer: Creo que los idiomas son las asignaturas más útiles porque te ayudan a conseguir un buen trabajo.
bullets.note: creo que (opinion) + superlative las asignaturas más útiles

bullets.prompt: Say which subject you dislike and why.
bullets.model_answer: No me gustan nada las matemáticas porque son muy aburridas y difíciles.
bullets.note: no me gustan nada (double negative required) + gustan plural (las matemáticas)

gold.ai_system_prompt: You are a GCSE Spanish examiner marking a role play about school subjects. The student was given a scenario and bullet points to respond to in Spanish. For each bullet, assess: (1) Did they communicate the required information? (2) Is the Spanish grammatically accurate? Check: gustar agreement (singular/plural), comparatives, superlatives, adjective agreement. Award marks out of 10 total. Be encouraging. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"Per-bullet feedback","improvement":"Key grammar point to revise"}

gold.question: Write 40-50 words in Spanish about your school subjects. Include: your favourite subject and why, a subject you dislike and why, a comparison between two subjects, and which subject you think is the most useful.
gold.ai_system_prompt: You are a GCSE Spanish examiner marking extended writing about school subjects. Mark on: Communication (all bullet points addressed?), Range of language (gustar, comparatives, superlatives, opinion phrases, varied adjectives), Accuracy (gustar singular/plural, adjective agreement with feminine nouns). The student was asked to write 40-50 words. Be encouraging and formative. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"3-4 sentences covering each criterion","improvement":"One specific grammar point to work on"}

gold.question: Listen and type what you hear
gold.audio_text: Mi asignatura preferida es la informática porque es la más divertida. Sin embargo, no me gustan nada las matemáticas porque son aburridas.
gold.correct_text: Mi asignatura preferida es la informática porque es la más divertida. Sin embargo, no me gustan nada las matemáticas porque son aburridas.
gold.translation: My favourite subject is ICT because it is the most fun. However, I don't like Maths at all because it is boring.

gold.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
gold.sentence: Las ciencias son más educativo que la educación física.
gold.explanation: Las ciencias is feminine plural. The adjective must agree: educativas (feminine plural), not educativo (masculine singular).
gold.translation: Science is more educational than PE.

ai_marking_prompts.role_play: You are a GCSE Spanish examiner marking a role play about school subjects. The student was given a scenario set at a leisure centre and bullet points to respond to in Spanish. For each bullet, assess: (1) Did they communicate the required information? (2) Is the Spanish grammatically accurate? Check in particular: gustar agreement (singular vs plural), comparative structures (más/menos + adj + que), superlative (las asignaturas más útiles), adjective agreement with feminine nouns (asignatura, historia, etc.). Award marks out of 10 total. Be encouraging. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"Per-bullet feedback","improvement":"Key grammar point to revise"}
ai_marking_prompts.writing: You are a GCSE Spanish examiner marking extended writing about school subjects. Mark on: Communication (favourite/disliked subject, comparison, most useful — all addressed?), Range of language (gustar/encantar, comparatives, superlatives, connectives like sin embargo/pero/también, opinion phrases creo que/en mi opinión), Accuracy (gustar agreement — me gustan las matemáticas, adjective agreement — feminine nouns like historia/asignatura/informática). Be encouraging and formative. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"3-4 sentences covering each criterion","improvement":"One specific grammar point to work on"}
